Compose table 4

compose_tbl4.Rd

Create a table with the distribution of strange cases

Usage

compose_tbl4(jecfa)

Arguments

jecfa

a data frame with the JECFA data

Value

a gtsummary table

Examples

jecfa_sample <- c(9:11) |>
  purrr::map(\(id) compose_jecfa_list(id) |> get_result()) |>
  create_df() |>
  process_df() |>
  add_metadata()

compose_tbl4(jecfa_sample)
